name: Dribble
description:
You bounce your orb to charge it with energy. Roll Dexterity against your orb's Difficulty. On a pass, add 1 MP to the orb and regain a half action. On a failure, the orb loses all its current MP and you do not regain a half action.

You must move at least 10 feet before you can use this ability again.

Describe your dribble.
successes:
✨: The orb is charged with 1 additional MP.

🌞: Your Speed increases by 5 ft for this turn.
